messages.content: "請你先使用'動態'分析模式，分析建築物編號為'B1234'的建築物結構，包括1樓、2樓、3樓和4樓。然後，可以檢索'1996年'的'麥可·喬丹'的球員統計數據嗎？之後，可以使用'靜態'分析模式，分析建築物編號為'B5678'的另一棟建築物結構，包括5樓、6樓、7樓和8樓。最後，可以檢索'2018年'的'勒布朗·詹姆斯'的球員統計數據嗎？特別是他在'洛杉磯湖人隊'的時間。"

function.name: analyze_structure
function.description: Analyze a structure of a building based on its Id and floor numbers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

building_id.description: The unique identification number of the building.

mode.description: Mode of analysis, e.g. 'static' or 'dynamic'. Default is 'static'.

function.name: player_statistic
function.description: Retrieves detailed player's statistics for a specific year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year for which the statistics will be displayed.

team_name.description: The name of the team(optional). Default is all if not specified.

message.reasoning:

First call to analyze_structure with mode='dynamic', building_id='B1234', floors=[1,2,3,4].

Second call to player_statistic with player_name='Michael Jordan'? Actually Chinese characters "麥可·喬丹". They want stats from 1996.

Third call to analyze_structure again but static mode, building_id='B5678', floors [5,6,7,8].

Fourth call to player_statistic for LeBron James (Chinese "勒布朗·詹姆斯") year=2018, team="Los Angeles Lakers".

[
 {"id":"analyze_dynamic","arguments":{"building_id":"B1234",...},"type":"function"},
 ...
]

But they said use 'functions.analyze_structure' etc. In earlier examples, they used "name": "functions.analyze_structure"? Wait example shows:

{
"type":"tool",

"id":"my_tool_0"
}

So maybe we follow that format: For each tool invocation, include "type":"tool", "name":"functions.<func>", "arguments":{...}, "id":"<unique>"

Thus produce array of such objects.

Let's craft IDs: dynamic_analysis_B1234, stat_jordan_1996, static_analysis_B5678, stat_lebron_lakers_2018.
